content: The listed copies of Sharḥ Ḥadīthayn (Arabic) begin with MS 10004/17 pp. 270-72 (Majlis, copied in Yazd 903-4/1497-98), MS 3035/7 (1084/1673) and MS Sipahsālār 2930 (undated); no copy in MS Majlis 10196 is listed. Variant titles are Sharḥ-i Dō Ḥadīs-i Nabavī and Javāb-i Chand Suʾāl dar Harāt (Answers to Several Questions in Herat).
refers_to_primary: Sharḥ Ḥadīthayn, MS list and variant titles
